themes.name: Push notifications
themes.description: Reviews about news alerts and push notifications, including whether they can be turned off or controlled in the app settings, how often they arrive, and how they behave when tapped.

themes.name: Playlist and queue
themes.description: Reviews about building and managing the audio playlist or queue, including whether it persists after closing the app, reordering, finding it, and loading more episodes.

themes.name: Streaming stability and buffering
themes.description: Reviews about audio that buffers, cuts out, disconnects, stops mid-story, or is slow to connect on Wi-Fi or mobile data, for live streams and on-demand audio.

themes.name: Skipping and wrong playback position
themes.description: Reviews about audio that skips or repeats sections, jumps back and forth, starts the next story midway, or restarts or resumes by itself after being paused.

themes.name: Live streams and local stations
themes.description: Reviews about finding, connecting to, and listening to live streams and local NPR stations, including missing stations, failed nearby-station search, and stations that won't play.

themes.name: Crashes and freezes
themes.description: Reviews about the app crashing, closing on its own, freezing, hanging, or failing to run on particular devices or Android versions.

themes.name: Background activity and battery
themes.description: Reviews about the app running in the background or at startup, and about its battery, data, and memory consumption.

themes.name: Interface design
themes.description: Reviews about the look, layout, navigation, and ease of use of the app, including outdated styling, Material Design, and how easy it is to find things.

themes.name: News bias and impartiality
themes.description: Reviews about NPR's political leaning, fairness, objectivity, and trustworthiness of its reporting, whether seen as balanced or biased.

themes.name: Content quality
themes.description: Reviews about the quality, depth, and value of NPR's journalism, stories, and programming, including praise for favorite shows and coverage.

themes.name: Program and podcast catalog
themes.description: Reviews about which shows, podcasts, and hourly news are available in the app, including missing or removed programs, outdated episodes, and programs that fail to load or play.
